description: A file with top-level `import`/`export` (or any file under `moduleDetection: force`). Has its own scope.
An import used only for types. Always erased from the JavaScript output.
`import { value, type SomeType }` marks individual specifiers as type-only.
Keeps imports without `type` exactly as written and drops imports with `type`. Required for safe single-file transpilation.
`with { type: 'json' }` describes how a non-JS module is loaded. Replaces the old `assert` syntax.
TypeScript's CommonJS import syntax. Not erasable, so modern code prefers ESM.
